docs.summary: When a [`PostEffect`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rendering.PostEffect) runs in the camera's frame.
After the opaques and sky, before the transparents, in linear light.
After the transparents and before tonemapping, in linear light, as bloom and depth of field are.

In place of the [`Tonemapping`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rendering.Tonemapping) component, as a custom tonemapper: the shader maps linear HDR light to linear 0 to 1, and the result is clamped and encoded for the display after it.
On the colour as it is displayed, after tonemapping.
